fib: ______ is a revealed religion which came to existence as a result of man's experience within his physical environment.

A ritual is a pattern of behavior of an individual or group of individuals.
______ is the ultimate fountain, head of all power and authority, of all sanctions for orderly relations between man.
God is the ultimate fountain, head of all power and authority, of all sanctions for orderly relations between man.
______ is a living religion and not likely to become extinct.
ATR is a living religion and not likely to become extinct.

Culture is the totality of a people's way of life.

Palm kernel oil is a taboo to Esu, in Yoruba.
